Implement Spring Boot 3 JPA entities and repositories matching V3 schema:
1. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/model/PasswordResetToken.java:
   - @Entity @Table(name = 'password_reset_tokens')
   - Long id, Long userId, String tokenHash, Instant expiresAt, boolean isUsed, Instant createdAt.
2. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/repository/PasswordResetTokenRepository.java:
   - JpaRepository<PasswordResetToken, Long>
   - Optional<PasswordResetToken> findByTokenHash(String tokenHash)
3. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/model/EmailVerificationToken.java:
   - @Entity @Table(name = 'email_verification_tokens')
   - Long id, Long userId, String tokenHash, Instant expiresAt, boolean isUsed, Instant createdAt.
4. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/repository/EmailVerificationTokenRepository.java:
   - JpaRepository<EmailVerificationToken, Long>
   - Optional<EmailVerificationToken> findByTokenHash(String tokenHash)
